summary: One week to FreightWorks Expo; the booth ships Thursday. Print files are with the printer, the scoring API is done, and the demo runs 1:50. Harbor's renewal (Oct 30) now hangs on contract redlines asking for an uptime clause. Pinecrest kickoff is Thursday, and the 10x load test runs today.

items.text: Harbor (38% of revenue, renews Oct 30) sent legal redlines overnight and wants an uptime clause before signing.
Maya is the owner of reviewing Harbor's contract redlines (TW-154), due Oct 29. It is todo.
Jordan's renewal paperwork with legal's changes (TW-158), a new order form once the uptime clause is agreed, is due Oct 30. It is todo.
Dana (Harbor) asked for a monthly sync uptime report to back the SLA. TW-155 is owned by Arjun, has no due date and is todo.
Dana (Harbor) asked for a weekly auto-export of the report every Monday. TW-156 is owned by Nina, has no due date and is todo.
Scoring API (TW-115) and Coastal ranking changes (TW-138) are both done and shipped.
Nina's 10x load test (TW-143) starts at 2pm today. It is due Oct 30.
Demo environment (TW-147, due Oct 29) still needs Coastal's anonymized week loaded. Arjun reports nothing blocking.
Booth print files (TW-150) are done and sent to the printer. The booth ships Thursday.
Demo runs 1:50, under Sam's two-minute target. Maya's booth script (TW-120) is done. Demo flow TW-119 is still in progress, due Oct 30.
Booth tablet mode works on the iPad. TW-149 is still in progress, due Oct 29.
Rate limits (TW-146, Arjun) moved to in progress, due Oct 30. Score caching (TW-148, Nina) is in progress, due Oct 30.
Pinecrest (third design partner, signed) kickoff is confirmed for Thursday. TW-151 is in progress, due Oct 29. Pinecrest wants to be live before Expo.
TW-121 (Coastal and Valley live on Smart Slots) is in progress, due Oct 30. Valley booked 140 slots through Smart Slots on Oct 26.
New ticket TW-157, booth slide loop for between demos, is due Oct 31 and is todo. The booth ships Thursday.
Maya moved investor meetings (TW-152, four at the booth, due Oct 30) and the launch announcement post (TW-153, due Nov 3) to in progress.
Booth staffing is two people at a time, in shifts. Maya wants to lock the shift plan Thursday.
Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow, renews Nov 20) had repeated duplicates; the root-cause fix has shipped. Renewal prep TW-113 is in progress, due Nov 13.
Smart Slots help center articles (TW-124, three articles) are in progress, due Nov 3.
Arjun is on call this week; Leila is on call the week of Nov 2.
